diffs.diff: distance_cm: datasheet reading gives 1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The 1 cm per count figure is real but applies only to the UART report frames, which this model does not decode. HLK-LD2410C serial protocol v1.00, Table 12 'Target basic information data composition': 'Movement target distance (cm) 2 bytes ... Distance to stationary target (cm) 2 bytes ... Detection distance (cm) 2 bytes', so raw count = cm. The model is a digital-out part read through pin 3 OUT (manual v1.00: 'Human presence detected: output high level / No human presence: output low level'; protocol 1.1: 'IO pin (someone high, no one low)'). Its sim is a digital-sensor on OUT and its driver reads only that pin, so it has no distance field and no conversion to check. Nothing in the model contradicts 1 cm/count, and TX/RX are documented as optional UART lines for distance data.
